description: This is an HTML file that implements the front-end user interface for a database visualizer. It contains structure, styles, and scripts to display databases, tables, and table data, with features like refreshing, expanding cells, and responsive layout.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for the selected table and renders it as an interactive table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds the HTML for displaying table data with headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content showing full data.
